title: Northgate Tire Center Package Terms — End of a Package and Refunds of Package Charges
content:
# End of a package and refunds of package charges

## When a Northgate Tire Center package ends

A package ends — is retired — on any of these events:

- the member reports the vehicle sold or the set removed from it;
- every tire of the set has been replaced outside the package;
- a full new set is installed on the vehicle.

While the package is not transferable, the package and every remaining protection end with the sale of the vehicle and never pass to the buyer or to another vehicle.

## No refund on retirement

Retirement refunds nothing: the installation package is a one-time service charge.

## The only refund of a package charge

The only refund of a package charge is a package refund credit when the Tire Center charged a component the package includes or charged twice for the same component, credited against that exact charge.

- **Grounds.** Either the charge is for something the package includes, or it is a second charge for the same component.
- **Object.** The refund credit is booked against the exact charge it refunds.
- **Once per charge.** A charge that already has a package refund credit standing against it in the package's records is not refunded again.

| Situation on the package | Package refund credit |
|---|---|
| A charge for a component the package includes | one credit against that charge |
| A second charge for the same component | one credit against that duplicate charge |
| A charge that already has a package refund credit against it | none further |
| The package is retired | nothing is refunded for the retirement |

## Hypothetical illustration

A package that includes the sensor service kit shows a kit charge on its installation date. That charge is refunded by one package refund credit booked against it. If the member later sells the vehicle, the package is retired and the installation package charge itself is not refunded.
